description: Tool to retrieve information about the currently authenticated Trello member. Use when you need profile details, settings, or member metadata.

actions.description: Optional parameter to include actions. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of action types.
actions.title: Actions

boardBackgrounds.description: Optional parameter to include board backgrounds. Valid values: 'all', 'none', or 'default'.
boardBackgrounds.title: Board Backgrounds

boardStars.description: Optional parameter to include board stars. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.
boardStars.title: Board Stars

boards.description: Optional parameter to include boards. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of board filters.
boards.title: Boards

boardsInvited.description: Optional parameter to include boards the member is invited to. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.
boardsInvited.title: Boards Invited

cards.description: Optional parameter to include cards. Accepts 'all', 'none', or card filter values like 'open', 'closed', 'visible'.
cards.title: Cards

customBoardBackgrounds.description: Optional parameter to include custom board backgrounds. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.
customBoardBackgrounds.title: Custom Board Backgrounds

customEmoji.description: Optional parameter to include custom emoji. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.
customEmoji.title: Custom Emoji

customStickers.description: Optional parameter to include custom stickers. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.
customStickers.title: Custom Stickers

fields.description: Comma-separated list of member fields to return. Use 'all' for all fields. Valid field names: id, activityBlocked, avatarHash, avatarUrl, avatarSource, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idEnterprise, idEnterprisesDeactivated, idMemberReferrer, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, nonPublic, nonPublicAvailable, products, url, username, status, aaId, aaEmail, email, gravatarHash, idBoards, idBoardsPinned, idOrganizations, loginTypes, oneTimeMessagesDismissed, prefs, premiumFeatures, trophies, uploadedAvatarHash.
fields.title: Fields

name: get_members_me

BioData.description: Structured biography data containing emoji information.

emoji.description: Emoji data associated with the bio.
emoji.title: Emoji

BioData.title: BioData

GetMembersMeResponse.description: Response schema for `GetMembersMe` - authenticated Trello member information.

url.description: URL to the member's Trello profile page.
url.title: Url

aaId.description: Atlassian account ID for the member.
aaId.title: Aa Id

idOrganizations.description: Array of organization/workspace IDs the member belongs to.
idOrganizations.title: Id Organizations

aaEmail.description: Email address associated with the Atlassian account (nullable).
aaEmail.title: Aa Email

uploadedAvatarHash.description: Hash of the member's uploaded avatar image (nullable).
uploadedAvatarHash.title: Uploaded Avatar Hash

idEnterprise.description: Identifier of the enterprise the member belongs to (null if not part of an enterprise).
idEnterprise.title: Id Enterprise

idBoardsPinned.description: Array of board IDs the member has pinned.
idBoardsPinned.title: Id Boards Pinned

idBoards.description: Array of board IDs the member has access to.
idBoards.title: Id Boards

email.description: Member's standard email address (nullable, not always returned).
email.title: Email

idEnterprisesDeactivated.description: Array of enterprise IDs where the member has been deactivated.
idEnterprisesDeactivated.title: Id Enterprises Deactivated

gravatarHash.description: Gravatar hash for the member's avatar.
gravatarHash.title: Gravatar Hash

confirmed.description: Whether the member's email verification is complete.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

avatarUrl.description: Direct URL to the member's avatar image.
avatarUrl.title: Avatar Url

memberType.description: Type of membership the user has.
memberType.title: Member Type

products.description: Array of Trello products/plans the member has access to.
products.title: Products

trophies.description: Array of achievements or badges earned by the member.
trophies.title: Trophies

loginTypes.description: Array of authentication methods used by the member (nullable).
loginTypes.title: Login Types

activityBlocked.description: Whether the member's activity is blocked.
activityBlocked.title: Activity Blocked

avatarHash.description: Hash string for the member's avatar image.
avatarHash.title: Avatar Hash

oneTimeMessagesDismissed.description: Array of one-time message IDs that the member has dismissed (nullable).
oneTimeMessagesDismissed.title: One Time Messages Dismissed

id.description: Unique identifier for the member (24-character hexadecimal string).
id.title: Id

idPremOrgsAdmin.description: Array of organization IDs where the member has admin privileges for premium organizations.
idPremOrgsAdmin.title: Id Prem Orgs Admin

idMemberReferrer.description: ID of the member who referred this member (nullable).
idMemberReferrer.title: Id Member Referrer

avatarSource.description: Source of the avatar (can be 'atlassian' or null).
avatarSource.title: Avatar Source

premiumFeatures.description: Array of premium features available to the member.
premiumFeatures.title: Premium Features

bioData.description: Structured biography data containing emoji information.
bioData.title: Bio Data

GetMembersMeResponse.title: GetMembersMeResponse

minutesBetweenSummaries.description: Frequency in minutes for summary notifications.
minutesBetweenSummaries.title: Minutes Between Summaries
